items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Dr. Jones called me. She said, 'Arnett?' I said, 'Yes, Dr. Jones.' ... She said, 'Elizabeth is dead.'

ctx.x: Dinah was beautiful. She took care of her mother. She bought her mother a home in Chicago and bought a car for her stepdaddy, Buick, and she was a lucky girl because she was good to her mother. She was good to her mother. And her mother was the only one that she wouldn't talk back to. She'd talk back to anybody but Ms. Jones. See, Dinah's real name was Ruth Jones. But Ms. Jones would take her back hand and clap her in the mouth if she said anything, and Dinah respected that woman. I was half scared of her myself.
